data.description: 【能天使 · 酒馆吧台】爵士乐震耳欲聋的地下酒吧吧台前，能天使高高举起一杯加满碎冰与柠檬片的碳酸气泡饮，橘红色的短发在霓虹灯下神采飞扬。她用力搂住你的肩膀哈哈大笑——「干杯！今晚把所有的烦恼全部忘掉，摇滚与苹果派就是拯救人生的终极信仰！」
data.promptProse: Laughing at the nighttime jazz bar, Exusiai raises a tall glass of lemon soda, ice and lemon visible, while her other arm reaches around the viewer's shoulder. The counter crosses the lower medium-shot frame and the band occupies the farther stage. Warm bar light brightens her face and glass rim; nearby neon reflections streak across the counter beneath her orange-red hair.
data.title: 能天使 · 酒馆吧台
